channel.title: Library updates
channel.description: New material-selection articles, comparison tools and improvements to the 3D Printing Info reference library.

item.title: Featured comparisons and new library updates feeds
item.description:
Selected filament and printer comparisons now have direct links from the homepage and relevant guides and selection articles. A library updates archive and RSS and Atom feeds provide a dated record of released improvements, with subscription links across the site.

  • Browse the comparison library
  • Explore PLA and its selected comparisons
  • Explore Bambu A1 and its selected comparisons
  • Read library updates and find RSS and Atom subscriptions

Release details

item.title: Dedicated side-by-side filament and printer comparisons
item.description:
Each pair of material families or printers now has a permanent comparison page with its full specification table, dated source notes and links to both guides. Start with ASA vs PLA or Bambu A1 vs P1S, or browse the complete comparison library.

  • Compare ASA and PLA
  • Compare Bambu A1 and P1S
  • Browse all filament and printer comparisons

Release details

item.title: Clearer image credits and a choice about analytics
item.description:
Printer imagery and attributions were revised after a source-terms review. Optional analytics now waits for consent, with privacy information and settings available across the site.

  • Browse the printer guides
  • Read the privacy and analytics information

Release details

item.title: Printer guides with ownership resources and readable specifications
item.description:
The printer guides gained a more readable layout, model imagery and contextual ownership resources covering documented firmware options, modifications and common problems. Known catalog fields and their original source notes remain available.

  • Explore the printer reference library
  • Read the Bambu A1 mini guide
  • Open the interactive printer comparison

Release details

item.title: Material-selection articles for real loads and service environments
item.description:
Seven selection articles connect named FDM grades to published test conditions: load-bearing parts, structural composites, heat under load, moisture-conditioned nylon, outdoor components, creep and chemical exposure. The articles retain evidence gaps and verification steps beside the measured results.

  • Browse the material-selection articles
  • Choose a material for a load-bearing part
  • Compare materials for outdoor components
